## Generation prompt

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide GitHub profile README banner, landscape 3:1 composition. Create an original understated anime illustration of a young adult developer seen from behind in three-quarter view at a desk, quietly building a small software project late at night. A laptop screen gives off a subtle pale cyan light; through a large window is a rainy city skyline at blue hour, tiny warm apartment lights. Hand-drawn Japanese animation aesthetic, delicate clean linework, painterly atmosphere, cinematic composition, nuanced muted midnight navy, slate blue, soft teal and a little warm amber. Calm, thoughtful, quietly inventive mood. The room and window dominate; character occupies only a small portion of the frame. Restrained detail, generous breathing room, beautiful natural light. Designed to sit above short text on a dark GitHub profile. No typography, no logos, no watermark, no UI screenshot, no collage, no neon cyberpunk clutter. Render a finished wide horizontal illustration.

### Generation prompt

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square GitHub profile avatar, designed for a circular crop and strong readability at small sizes. Input image: the referenced wide illustration is a style, palette, character and atmosphere reference only. Create a NEW close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of the original young adult anime developer from that scene, short softly tousled black hair, dark navy casual crewneck, calm attentive expression with a subtle friendly smile, facing the viewer at a slight three-quarter angle. Original fictional persona, not a likeness of a real person. Fine hand-drawn anime linework with restrained painterly shading matching the reference. Muted midnight navy and slate blue background, pale cyan monitor light on the face and a delicate warm amber rim light. Face and eyes must be clearly visible and luminous, enough contrast to remain readable at 40px. Simple softly blurred rainy window background, only a few subdued city bokeh lights. Center the head within the central 65 percent of the square, comfortable breathing room above the hair, shoulders inside the circular safe area. Quietly creative, minimal, understated. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no frame, no UI, no bright neon, no accessories or props. Render one finished 1:1 square illustration.
